Senses.Explanation: 雲門三句 are the three phrases later records associate with Yunmen: containing heaven and earth, following the waves, and cutting off the streams. Compilers and later masters enumerate, quote, and comment on the set; those later formulations are inherited classification, not three new sayings by every commentator.
